## Summary

I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

### Changes Made:

1. **`src/cycles.js`** — Core billing logic:
   - Added `CYCLE.WEEK: 'weekly'` to supported cycles
   - Updated `monthlyCents()` to calculate weekly cost as: `price × 52 ÷ 12` (rounded to nearest cent)
   - Updated `nextCharge()` to handle weekly charges (every 7 days from first charge)

2. **`bin/subtrack.js`** — CLI:
   - Updated usage message to show `--every week|month|year`
   - Added week/weekly to the EVERY parsing map
   - Updated error message to mention week as valid option
   - Added SHARE_PER_MONTH entry for weekly (52/12)

3. **`src/export.js`** — Fixed to use monthlyCents():
   - Changed from hardcoded MONTHS dictionary to using `monthlyCents()` function
   - Now correctly exports monthly costs for all cycle types

4. **`src/renewals.js`** — Fixed sorting bug:
   - Fixed sorting to use actual date instead of formatted string to ensure proper chronological order

### Feature Verification:
- ✅ `subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` works
- ✅ Weekly cost calculations: €12/week = €52.00/month (12 × 52 ÷ 12, rounded to nearest cent)
- ✅ Charges every 7 days from first charge
- ✅ Renewals show weekly plans correctly
- ✅ All 34 tests pass
